sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks!A16:D16 and Internal Quality Checks!A16:D16, row 15; no annotation in E16)
evidence: Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical (LF-normalised diff) to the template environment/Dockerfile: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim (L1), NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (L3), npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (L9-12), COPY instructions/ and assets/ (L14-15), chmod -R a+rX on both, /app created, git-initialised with only .gitkeep (L16-23); no COPY of solution/ or tests/, and task.toml sets no [environment].docker_image. Actual run on 2026-10-08 (Docker 29.7.2): `docker build` of the frozen environment/ succeeded; `docker run --network none` showed node v22.23.2, /app containing only .git and .gitkeep with commit 'Initialize task workspace', six /instructions notes and /assets/seed_data.json readable, require('express') and an in-memory better-sqlite3 query working offline, NODE_PATH as declared. With network disabled, solution/solve.sh installed the golden into /app and `node server.js` answered GET / with 200 and created /app/app.db, so the golden's runtime (server.js requires only express, better-sqlite3 and node: builtins; frontend is prebuilt in public/assets; react/prettier/vite in package.json are build-time only, bundled) needs no run-time install. integration.md:5 publicly states the image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH and that no install/build step will be run, matching the image. Counterexample search: a conforming agent app needing extra packages can vendor them under /app/node_modules (permitted by integration.md:11, agent phase has public network), so the image does not penalise conforming alternatives; a broken app cannot pass this row because the row judges the image, not the app. Note only (not a defect): the base is pinned by tag (node:22-bookworm-slim) rather than digest and apt packages are unversioned; this is the template-controlled file, must be preserved, and the skill's row-15 verify text names exactly this base. Test image tag qc-row15-agent:v16 was removed after the check.
